Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly defined "AAS" as "Amino Acid Supplements" in the very first step. In the context of bodybuilding, "AAS" is the standard acronym for **Anabolic-Androgenic Steroids**, not amino acid supplements. This fundamental definition error led to an entirely wrong answer regarding what substance is commonly referred to by that specific abbreviation in the fitness community.
